notes.title: Playtest Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41984137/cc745ec06515734bc8fb8479b655340657b78107.png[/img]

Hello!

Yesterday we've launched Playtests and so far we see that many of you are enjoying our game. It means a lot to us.
We would like to thanks everyone that have sent the survey and bug reports on Steam forum.
We are fixing as many bugs as fast as we can, so if you find any kind of problem in the game, then try sending us report through any communication method that suits you the most (Discord, Steam, Survey).

Here are changes made in patch 1.2, that are live in the Playtest version of the game:
[list]
[*] customers don't stuck in tables 
[*] toilets are working now
[*] tips don't stuck outside of table
[*] more walls to paint
[*] added loading screen after story line
[*] customers look at cashier right now, not to the side
[*] fixed customers going to table with another customer - then to cashier
[*] fixed crashes after story line
[*] fixed reputation stars problem
[*] now when you place furniture or kitchen things - it's initially oriented on the player
[*] fixed pictures that didn't place on walls
[*] fixed some lamps 
[*] fixed problem when you could equip couple of tools at once
[*] fixed sounds that were very high pitched, which was unpleasant to hear
[/list]
